blurb.en: Eight-step gate sequencer, each step a three-way switch: off, tied or short gate. Reset input keeps patterns any length you want.
blurb.fi: Kahdeksanaskelinen gate-sekvensseri, jokainen askel kolmiasentoinen kytkin: pois, sidottu tai lyhyt gate. Reset-tulo pitää kuvion minkä pituisena haluat.
blurb.sv: Åttastegs gate-sekvensiator, varje steg en trevägsomkopplare: av, bunden eller kort gate. Reset-ingång håller mönstret hur långt du vill.

pull.q: Designed to give a quick and simple way to generate rhythmic sequences while jamming.

quotes.t: An eight-step switchable gate sequencer. Each step has a three position switch for off, short gate and tied gate.
